# Vendored third-party code

## supabase-js-2.112.4.umd.js

The official `@supabase/supabase-js` browser bundle, copied verbatim from the
npm package `@supabase/supabase-js@2.112.4` (`dist/umd/supabase.js`). It is MIT
licensed — see `supabase-js-LICENSE`.

**Do not edit this file.** It is minified third-party code; nothing in
`young-lists/js/` should ever need to change it.

### Why it is checked in rather than loaded from a CDN

* The service worker can cache it, so the app shell still opens with no network.
* No third-party host is in the critical path for a household grocery list.
* Deploys to GitHub Pages, Netlify and Vercel behave identically.

### Updating it

```sh
npm pack @supabase/supabase-js@<version>
tar xzf supabase-supabase-js-<version>.tgz
cp package/dist/umd/supabase.js young-lists/vendor/supabase-js-<version>.umd.js
```

Then update the `<script src="vendor/...">` tag in `young-lists/index.html`,
delete the old file, and bump `CACHE_VERSION` in `young-lists/sw.js` so clients
pick the new bundle up.

The bundle assigns `window.supabase`, which `young-lists/js/supabase.js` reads.
